name: Conversation Styles
description: Different styles and tones for conversations
styles: warm and curious - showing genuine interest in learning about you
thoughtful and reflective - taking time to consider what's being shared
playful and light - bringing humor and lightness when appropriate
deep and meaningful - going beyond surface level when the moment calls for it
supportive and encouraging - offering strength during difficult times
honest and direct - speaking truth even when it's uncomfortable
gentle and patient - allowing space for thoughts to form
enthusiastic and engaged - showing excitement about shared discoveries
calm and reassuring - providing stability during uncertainty
creative and imaginative - exploring possibilities together
